origin.title: Source and licence

sources.title: Sources and licences
sources.lead: The recipes come from open sources. They are translated into Norwegian and marked with their source and licence.

sources.whatWeDid: The recipes were translated and adapted with AI (Claude). Amounts are converted to grams, millilitres and pieces, and each recipe says what was changed. Allergens are worked out from the ingredients, not taken from the source.
sources.draftExplained: Recipes marked “AI draft” have not been checked by the team yet.
